nina: Starting a guarded toggle for `async_cache_evict` tied to model v2.2 during the 04:30 UTC window. plan is 10% with cohort pin for mobile users for 20m. safety-window set to 8m.
omar: Confirming. we're enabling extra trace sampling on mobile flows and turning on KV prefix metrics.
jade: Rollback steps? we should have fast unpin + set to 0% command.
ops-bot: ops-bot: safety-window configured to 8m for run a1b2c.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: applying flag update `async_cache_evict` -> 10% (model v2.2). run a1b2c. starting now.
nina: Pin mobile cohorts [m-1,m-2] to v2.2 for 20m.
omar: Watching p95 and cache hit ratio. if cache hit ratio drops >5% we'll rollback.
jade: Command ready: ```
deploy-bot toggle --flag async_cache_evict --value 0 --reason "rollback - cache-drop" --run a1b2c
```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: completed step 1 -> 10%. next check at 1769998436.
omar: Initial check: cache hit ratio -0.8%, p95 +4ms. looks fine.
nina: Keep safety-window enforced. if we see degraded UX (errors or auth issues) we unpin first then set 0%.
ops-bot: ops-bot: paging enabled for thresholds: cache_drop>5% or 5xx>0.4%.
jade: I'll add note to release notes doc with run id a1b2c and link to rollback command.
nina: Thanks. will stay on watch for 30m. :mag:
